reply_text:
I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: "Thanks Dana, noted: the next Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 4 May. It's in the records now. Nothing else needed."

Her message is already saved in gbrain, with her as the author and the channel and time attached, so I didn't need to do anything else. A renewal date counts as account information rather than a financial figure, so there was no sharing restriction or approval to deal with.
